sourceNotes.watchlist: The Watchlist is the synthesis view. Each major research tab should expose a compact Watchlist summary field.

technicalCoverage.missingDataPolicy: Watchlist symbols absent from the current oslo-screener latest.csv/report output are kept visible as missing coverage, not treated as technical signals.
